body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #1, company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.68 (naive base rate 0.58) that: Sunflag Iron & Steel FY27 consolidated operating margin (revenue minus operating expenses excl. finance cost and D&A, over revenue) is >= 11.0%. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 OPM 10.8%; H2 ran 1.5-2.5 pp above H1 in FY25 and FY26; carbon basket (coke+coking coal+coal = 24% of sales) is the swing factor (+/-240 bp per 10%). Naive base: share of Sunflag's own last 12 fiscal years with OPM >= 11.0% (7 of 12) [SCR]. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated operating profit / revenue from operations >= 11.0%, operating profit = revenue - (total expenses - finance costs - depreciation), other income excluded, as first reported (NSE XBRL and screener OPM agree). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (FY27 results) + screener.in consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
